note: Both sets contain significant errors in the Millwork Schedule section, misbinding tags to dimensions and descriptions of other items. Set A has 3 misbound claims (MWK05, MWB01, MWK04 dimensions), while Set B has 4 misbound claims (MWL01 type, MWK04, MWB01, MWK05 descriptions/dimensions). Set B is worse because it incorporates incorrect descriptions into the entity names (e.g., calling MWL01 a 'Horizontal Cabinet' when it is a 'Base Cabinet'), which is more misleading than Set A's use of correct tags with wrong values.
